The ticket is **#8841**. I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random.

The number comes from Tobias, who posted in #central-random on Oct 13 at 9:27. He said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841.

One part is my inference. Tobias didn't name Marrow Fieldworks; he said the issue was on his dealer account. A January handoff note says Marrow Fieldworks moved off Pree's dealer account on Jan 5, but it doesn't say who took it over. I assumed that was Tobias. I told Pree this in my reply and suggested she check with Tobias before the call to be sure.

I only used #central-random and Central team files Pree can see herself.
